native.en: A quick tour of the viewport, utilities, and panels before you start composing.

native.en: This is your 3D scene — orbit, pan, and zoom to look around.

native.en: Browse the Objects available to place from here.

native.en: Reverts the most recent edit on the open artifact and moves its head back one revision.
